decisions.reason: The original reaction-feasibility clause fixed phase coordinates but not auxiliary states. The current isolated-compound Definition and entropy-maximum Postulate explicitly retain variable auxiliary entropy. Along a feasible reaction curve, stationarity therefore gives 0=-(nu^r)^T mu^alpha/T+(d/dt)S_aux, not zero affinity. Pairwise fixed-auxiliary feasibility does not supply a reaction curve with this extra derivative zero. This is a missing hypothesis in the physical deduction, hence a fatal logic defect. The repair explicitly requires complete bilateral reaction curves with every auxiliary state fixed, and the proof now differentiates one C2 phase entropy plus constant contributions. The full-rank dimension conclusion is preserved.
